topic: Fundamentals of Linear Algebra: Vectors as Spatial Guides

sections.title: What is a Vector? (Visualizing Movement)
sections.content: Introduce vectors as directed line segments in 2D space defined by magnitude and direction. Explain how a vector acts as an 'instruction' to move from an origin (0,0) to a coordinate (x,y).
sections.example: Visualize a robotic turtle starting at the origin; a vector [3, 2] is the specific command for it to walk 3 units right and 2 units up.

sections.title: Vector Addition: The Head-to-Tail Rule
sections.content: Demonstrate that adding vectors corresponds to sequential movements. Graphically, this is shown by placing the tail of the second vector at the head of the first.
sections.example: The turtle walks [3, 2] (first vector), then walks [1, 4] (second vector). The 'resultant' vector is the straight path from the origin to the turtle's final position [4, 6].

sections.title: Scalar Multiplication: Stretching Space
sections.content: Explain how multiplying a vector by a scalar (number) changes its length but keeps its orientation (unless negative). This 'stretches' or 'shrinks' the vector graphically.
sections.example: If a bird is flying along vector [1, 1], multiplying by 2 results in [2, 2], visually doubling the length of the flight path while maintaining the same diagonal angle.

sections.title: Basis Vectors: The Building Blocks
sections.content: Define 'i' [1, 0] and 'j' [0, 1] as the unit basis vectors. Explain that any 2D vector is simply a linear combination: x*i + y*j.
sections.example: Think of [3, 2] as a recipe: 3 portions of 'horizontal unit move' plus 2 portions of 'vertical unit move'. This shows why these two vectors are the 'grid' for all 2D space.

sections.title: Summary & Synthesis
sections.content: Recap that linear algebra is the study of how these spatial instructions combine to transform the entire grid, setting the stage for matrices and transformations.
sections.example: Summarize how simple vectors (arrows) form the coordinate system used in every video game to animate characters moving across a screen.
